findings.issue: Parallel mode ignores per-agent timeout parameter
findings.description: The _run_agents_parallel function wraps each agent in asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=AGENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS), but the inner _run_agent_safe call receives the legacy timeout parameter (which defaults to REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=180) and never uses it for agent-level gating. This creates a dead parameter in the signature. If AGENT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS and REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS diverge, the behavior becomes unclear. Remove the timeout parameter from _run_agent_safe signature or document that it's unused in the current implementation.
findings.action: Remove the unused timeout parameter from _run_agent_safe function signature, or add a comment documenting that agent-level timeout is enforced by the asyncio.wait_for wrapper in parallel mode, not by this parameter.
